name: Single-Obstruction PC-Minor Basis for Hypercellular Graphs
statement: A finite partial cube is hypercellular if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $Q_3^-$.
proof: This is the defining forbidden-minor clause of the hypercellular characterization theorem; $Q_3^-$ is itself nonhypercellular and its proper pc-minors avoid it.
